notes.title: Update #4 - Song Previews and Improved Options
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I have a bunch of new things for you in this update.

 - Clicking on a song in the list now plays a preview of the audio.
 - The options menu has been redesigned as it was becoming cluttered. It is now split into four sections - display, audio, gameplay and controls.
 - Added an option in fullscreen mode to change the black borders to be colourful and more attractive.
 - Added an option to turn off the sounds that are played when you miss a note or make a mistake.
 - Added an option to reset your controls to the default.
 - Fixed a bug where the taskbar icon would disappear.

Let me know what you think! 

Blake.

notes.title: Update #3 - 100% Tracking and Lefty Flip
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This new update includes two new features.

The game now keeps track of which songs you have hit 100% of notes on and displays '100%' next to them.

There is also a left-handed mode in which the note chart is flipped, like other games.

Let me know what you think!

Blake.

notes.title: Update #2 - No-Strum Mode Beta + More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

My internet connection is still down, but I decided to take my PC over to a friend's place so I could bring you this update!

The most notable feature in this update is the addition of the highly requested no-strum mode, which I'm calling 'tap mode'. I'm releasing it as a beta to begin with to make sure that there's no major bugs or other issues with the engine and the leaderboards will be disabled temporarily for this time.

The second change in this update is that hammer-ons can now be strummed!

And finally, I have added a note speed setting to the options menu. You may now increase the scrolling speed of the notes if you wish. However, there is only two settings, 'slow' (3 pixels per frame) and 'fast' (4 pixels per frame). I can't offer more settings than this because using fractional numbers causes too many issues.

Hope you like it!

Blake.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Based on your feedback, I have just made an update with the following changes:

- Hitboxes have been slightly increased in size to allow more room for error with your timing.
- The track editor now allows BPMs to contain 2 decimal places instead of 1.
- The option to set the offset between the notes and music was previously restricted to a range of -100 to 100. This has been increased to -500 to 500.
- A help button has been added to the custom songs page that explains how to configure them, as some people were having trouble.

Let me know what you think of these changes in the comments here or in a discussion topic.

Thanks!

PS: I am in the process of making a no-strum mode, as this is the most requested feature so far.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: I have just made an update to correct a bug with the leaderboards. They were only displaying the top 10 scores, despite there being 25 slots. You should now be able to see all 25.
